messages:
Sam B.: Quick alert — automation created extra NS invoices for a set of Stripe usage invoices tied to the experimental tiered-pricing run. Not many, but enough to skew MRR numbers in the dashboard.

Sam B.: Log snippet:
```
2026-01-15T04:10:02Z INFO receive_stripe_event evt=evt_1Lz... type=invoice.finalized id=in_3Yz
2026-01-15T04:10:05Z INFO ns_create external_ref=stripe:in_3Yz status=201 ns=NSINV-4521
2026-01-15T04:10:05Z INFO ns_create external_ref=stripe:in_3Yz:rend_abc status=201 ns=NSINV-4522
```

Priya K.: Rend_abc? That looks like rendering id appended. We only dedupe on external_ref so that'll miss duplicates.

Diego R.: Confirmed: pricing-render service emits a render_id for display. Reconciler mistakenly concatenates it into external_ref when price_adjustment present. Code: external_key = f"stripe:{id}{':' + render_id if render_id else ''}". Will patch.

Sam B.: Can accounting void the duplicates? We need the later NS IDs voided and a memo recorded.

Lena A.: Yes. Please create an ACCT ticket with the list (Stripe id + NS id pairs) and the suggested memo text. We'll perform reversal once ticket is approved.

acct-bot: Created ACCT-2098: Reconciler created duplicate NetSuite invoices for tiered-pricing experiment.

Diego R.: Plan: 1) Hotfix reconciler to ignore transient render_id in external_ref. 2) Add idempotency: query NetSuite by exact stripe:{invoice_id} only. 3) Run backfill that finds stripe ids with >1 NS invoice and generate CSV for accounting.

Sam B.: Also need to re-run daily_revenue_job for 2026-01-15 after voids are applied.

Priya K.: Make sure the backfill doesn't auto-void — just flag and produce CSV. Accounting will perform voids manually and post audit notes.

Diego R.: Agreed. I'll push PR with tests and run on staging. I'll add a monitoring rule: if reconciler creates >1 NS invoice for same stripe id in 48h, emit a critical metric.

Lena A.: For the memo use: "duplicate created by reconciler — transient render id appended". Add me to ACCT-2098.

Sam B.: Thanks — please ping in #finance when prod deploy + backfill complete. :thumbsup:
